snippet.title: Baking yummy 🍩😋 with CSS variables
snippet.description:
Note that this demo is WebKit-only since Firefox and Edge don't support using calc() inside rotate() transform functions.

For years, I've used two separate nested elements to position and animate one and the same thing in 3D. This is because, if I use up the transform property with the 3D positioning then I can only use it for the animation if I chain the positioning transforms in front of those I animate. But this would mean one set of keyframe animations for each and every element even though they're animated the same way, it's just that they're in different position.

Fortunately, now we can do better using CSS variables. Link to demo created in the video https://codepen.io/thebabydino/pen/BWZrwG/

snippet.title: Speech bubbles & waves with pure CSS (no SVG, no JS)
snippet.description:
It all started from the Basic Shapes & Path… Never the Twain Shall Meet? article on CSS-Tricks which you can read if you follow this link after the arrow https://css-tricks.com/basic-shapes-path-never-twain-shall-meet/

The article says that you cannot clip an element to a speech bubble or shape with a wavy edge using clip-path with a basic shape value, so I thought I'd have a bit of fun and try to do that.

DISCLAIMER

Don't recommend this in practice. Resulting code (compiled CSS) is yucky. Just did it as a fun exercise showin the power of Sass + clip-path.

DEMO http://codepen.io/thebabydino/pen/PWyBNY/

NOTES

* for this to work in Firefox now, set the layout.css.clip-path-shapes.enabled to true in about:config; this will change soon https://twitter.com/jensimmons/status/828950022007902209

*  no need for any prefix other than the -webkit- one; there is no prefix in my code because I'm using Autoprefixer

* Edge doesn't yet support clip-path on HTML elements, but you can vote for it https://wpdev.uservoice.com/forums/257854-microsoft-edge-developer/suggestions/6519995-support-clip-path-property - please do if you want this cross-browser, they do prioritise based on number of votes as well
